attribute_cases.note: Jeans means trousers AND denim on the same lower garment, not merely any trousers. This alias requires approval as part of the language contract.

invariants: All source spans index the actual original text.
No new context, role, dress-code, ranking term, or automatic evidence source.
Soft wording never becomes a hard condition; persisted P1/P2 remains the ranking authority.
Multiple clauses bind to one actual member only with licensed same-member wording.
No sentence-boundary truncation or deletion of unknown meaningful text.
limits: Finite deterministic grammar cannot understand arbitrary English.
Specialist alternatives remain unsupported by existing 15-context refinement policy.
amendment: N45 recognizes a soft request but requires the existing preference-settings action. Existing policies reject nonempty soft_preferences; silently dropping it or adding request-local ranking would change the mathematical contract. No soft clause is turned into a hard condition. Existing resource and historical meaning assertions remain unchanged.
